skills.name: Like-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Find equivalent fractions with a common denominator in order to subtract fractional quantities with unlike denominators.

skills.name: Mixed-number subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed or whole-number quantities when the fractional part of the minuend is at least as large as the fractional part being subtracted.

skills.name: Regrouping in fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow one whole and convert it to a fractional form when subtracting from a whole number or when the minuend's fractional part is too small.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed numerals
skills.definition: Interpret and convert mixed-number forms with improper fractional parts, such as 2 4/3, before completing subtraction.
